name: Mirai Kanojo
source:
Takaya had started going out with a girl who he had been interested in for quite some time and was looking forward to enjoying a lovey-dovey relationship. But then another girl showed up, who was the same girl from another time (whether it be from the future, past or as another form in the present)!?

“Which of us do you like!?” 

How could he choose between them? They were both his dearest lover and possessed different charms. But of course there’s only one answer…

“I’ll go out with both of you!”

This was the beginning of a strange love triangle.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/03/09/march-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
孝也终于与暗恋已久的女孩交往，期待享受甜蜜恋爱。然而，另一个女孩出现了，她竟是来自另一个时间的同一个女孩（可能来自未来、过去，或是现在的另一种形态）！？

“你喜欢我们中的谁！？”

他怎么可能在两人之间选择？她们都是最珍爱的恋人，各自拥有不同魅力。但答案当然只有一个……

“我两个都要交往！”

奇怪三角恋就此开始。

[译自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/03/09/march-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
